offset
Starts at offset: 0. Each new event (AuthActivityAuditEvent, DetectionSummaryEvent, UserActivityAuditEvent) would increase the
offset counter by one. When reconnecting to the Falcon Streaming API, you can specify the offset value to tell the API the starting
point where you’d like to receive the events. If omitted, the API would return all previous detection Summary or authentication events
starting with offset=0.
